lines.id: Pagi bulan Juni, hujan tak henti
lines.en: A June morning in the monsoon rain

lines.id: Kita melangkah di jalan yang sama
lines.en: We set out on the same road
Who was a friend, who was a stranger

lines.id: Tak ada yang tahu, di dalam kabut
lines.en: No one could tell, in the fog
You took my trembling hand
It is all right, we are brothers
Hyung, go first

lines.id: Jembatan ini biar aku yang jaga
lines.en: Let me hold this bridge
Go, and do not look back
Stay alive, and get home
The rice ball Mother packed for us
I remember the night I gave it to you
If someone has to stay behind
I am glad that it is me

lines.id: Kudekap namamu yang basah oleh hujan
lines.en: I hold your rain-soaked name to my heart
Step by step, cross into the dawn
I will leave you a road back
The door of home stays open
Hyung, go first

lines.id: Jembatan ini biar aku yang jaga
lines.en: Let me hold this bridge
Go, and do not look back
Stay alive, and get home
When the rain stops, come and find me

lines.id: Kita bertemu lagi di kampung halaman
lines.en: We will meet again at home
